Design has 22 distinct clock domains (AC_GND_U10_CLK_IN_N, AC_GND_U8_CLK_REF_N, AC_GND_U9_CLK_N, AC_GND_Y1_CLK_REF_N, AC_GND_Y2_CLK_REF_N, CLK_ADC_N, CLK_ADC_P, LO_N_U8, LO_N_Y1, LO_N_Y2, LO_P_U8, LO_P_Y1, LO_P_Y2, PD_U10_CLK_IN_P, PD_U8_CLK_REF_P, PD_U9_CLK_P, PD_Y1_CLK_REF_P, PD_Y2_CLK_REF_P, SPI_SPI_CLK_U8, SPI_SPI_CLK_U9, SPI_SPI_CLK_Y1, SPI_SPI_CLK_Y2) but no CDC synchroniser / FIFO / dual-port cell is declared in the BOM. Metastability risk unless RTL adds 2FF synchronisers at every crossing.
